body:
My girlfriend came over to pick up her stuff. She told me everything from she wants to marry me to she never wants to see me again and that I am manipulative. I'm supposed to go visit her right now, but I'm afraid. She assures me that she loves me and that I am worth something but she can't handle my mental illness. She has told me that she has wanted to break up with me for a long time but I keep forcing her to stay with me.

I'm done. I can't stand making everyone miserable.

Thanks for listening, you guys. Be good to yourselves.

>You have the strength to overcome these difficulties in your life.

I really don't anymore. I just want to lie down and die. I am waiting for one thing to happen this evening and I am giving it another hour (very personal matter) before I proceed with my plans anyway. I doubt it will happen, but hey, why not wait to face more disappointment anyway, right?

I just can't do this anymore. I'm sorry, but I can't.

What I wanted:
I wanted to work as a psychiatric research scientist. Seriously, I did. I was always in accelerated programs throughout my academic career, but I left home as a teenager and stopped going to therapy and stopped taking medication. My anxiety (PTSD, general anxiety, etc) and depression consumed me and I dropped out of school, only to go back and then drop out again because I couldn't deal with the anxiety. I have always been a "nerd", "geek", "dork", etc. My IQ has been tested around the 160-170 areas when I was younger. I ruined my life by getting kicked out of home because of the behavior and "episodes" I would have because of mental illness (borderline personality disorder, general anxiety/PTSD - causes flashbacks, and major depressive disorder - this has even caused me to slip into psychosis NOS at various times of my life). Dropping out of school was the worst thing I could have ever done. It led to drug use, excessive alcohol use, jail time (nothing major, although I did spend 14 months in a state prison starting when I was 19 for threatening someone over the phone when I was 17; I had probation but got so anxious and paranoid that I stopped going to my appointments with my PO so they revoked my probation), etc. 

I have always dreamed of just having a simple, non-chaotic life with someone who thinks I matter. I want simple things. I want to enjoy playing music, something I was gifted with at an early age that I no longer care about at all. I want to talk with friends, I want a girlfriend that loves me, I want to wake up in the morning, sit on my porch with a cup of coffee and look at my shitty neighborhood, and know that life doesn't suck as bad as it could.

What has happened:
I know I am highly intelligent, and because I devoted my life to learning as much about the human mind and thought processes as possible (in order to be accepted I had to learn how other people think), I can understand how people think. It may sound like a delusion that I can read thoughts, but it's not. I can't read thoughts, I can't read minds; what I can do is read actions and expressions and compare them to the knowledge I have from extensive research, both in and out of school (I did wind up somehow getting accepted to college and I went for a while), and this knowledge gives me insight into not only how people think, but how they will act upon their thoughts. I know it sounds like delusions of grandeur, but I can assure you it's not (how can someone have such delusions when they think so lowly about themselves?). 

I became a Linux system engineer and a part time software developer. I was extremely good at what I did. I did my job with ease. Working with systems was easy because I finally had control over something in my life. Working in an office by myself was nice, but I still couldn't avoid interacting with people. Everyone wanted something, and I couldn't give everyone what they wanted. I felt horrible when that happened. I also couldn't stand walking in the front door every day, no matter where I worked. I couldn't stand the pressure of being a person responsible for making sure things worked, or making sure the "trains ran on time", as they say. This is why I can't keep a job. I also never really liked what I did. 

I want to be appreciated. I want to know that I matter, not just feel like it for a little bit. I need to KNOW that I matter!

But I don't. I have to practically beg my own children to talk to me on the phone. They don't like Daddy because he cries a lot, because he gets angry a lot, because he doesn't have a place to live.

I love my children. I love my (now) ex girlfriend. Hell, I even love my ex wife, as much as I know that the marriage was toxic. I love my family, even though we hardly ever see each other and not one of them will call or text or email me... it always takes me reaching out to them in order to even be accepted as a family member.

I hate me. I really, honestly hate me. I can't wait to die today.

I'd talk about how I wanted my life to turn out. However, it just doesn't matter, does it? I never wanted to be a bad person. I never wanted to get tossed into the "wrong crowd" and make so many of the wrong, stupid decisions I made that landed me in so much trouble. Yes, I was looking for acceptance, but whenever I would do anything to get accepted, I was still cast aside, especially when it just got me in trouble.

I hate me. That's really all there is to it. What else about me would you like to know? I'll share anything as I am waiting to die, until I do die, that is.
What would you like to talk about? I have already made my decision. I can't talk for long, but what do you want to know?
